title: 为什么先看到闪电，再听到雷声
title_en: Why We See Lightning Before We Hear Thunder
summary_zh: 闪电和雷声其实是同时发生的，可我们总是先看到光、过几秒才听到声音。原因是光比声音快得多。读完你会用数秒的办法估算雷雨离你多远，也能用比较级和 if 句子解释一个现象。
body: During a storm, you often see a flash of lightning first. A few seconds later, you hear the thunder. But they happen at the same time. So why don't we see and hear them together? The answer is speed. Light travels very, very fast. It reaches your eyes almost at once. Sound is much slower. It needs about three seconds to travel one kilometre. This means you can guess how far away a storm is. When you see the lightning, start counting slowly. Stop when you hear the thunder. If you count six seconds, the storm is about two kilometres away. If the time between them gets shorter, the storm is coming closer, so it is a good idea to go inside.

speaking: 用 1 分钟给家人解释：打雷时为什么先看到闪电再听到雷声？怎么估算雷雨离你多远？用上 at the same time 和 much faster。
writing: 用 50–70 词写一段话，解释一个和速度有关的日常现象（如回声、闪电、跑步比赛），至少用一个比较级和一个 If… 句子。
